register.description: Register containing low power mode status bits. The status bits are set when the corresponding wakeup event happens and the corresponding enable in WAKEUP_CONFIG MMR is set. In addition, these bits are only set if clockstop request from PSC is active in order to ensure that these are captured only during low power mode and not during regular operation. These bits can only be set by hardware and once set, they can only be cleared by software by setting wakeup_stat_clear field.
